scope: Formula-only resident core on historical Task35 states. Isolate ionic prefix, readout and membrane solve costs without retraining or changing equations. No whole-simulator profile or learned speedup claim.
exclusions: Host event/plasticity/RNG generation, transfers, training, loading, graph capture and native simulation. Those remain part of open global IE-02 and are not declared solved.

targeting.policy: Diagnostic priorities only; qualify block conclusions where ABI is perturbed. No automatic candidate selection or training.

decision_policy: Describe an opportunity map, not a winning architecture. Compare stage opportunities within each execution mode. If instrumented full differs from legacy_abi by >=10%, flag ABI perturbation and qualify targeting conclusions. Cache effects interact through compiler fusion; fractions need not sum to 1. No architecture training, kernel rewrite, solver approximation, new dt or Task36 automatically authorized.
